The bear’s focus on negative book value [E2] ignores the company’s exceptional operational efficiency, as evidenced by an ROA of 14.11% which dwarfs the sector benchmark of 1.86% [E8]. While the bear highlights recent profit contraction [E20], this must be weighed against the company’s demonstrated ability to deliver massive compounded profit growth of 80% over the last three years and 43% over the last five years [E18, E19]. The claim that the market is pricing in unrealistic expectations [E50] is contradicted by the extreme valuation discount, where the stock trades at a P/E of 1.93x compared to a sector benchmark of 18.28x [E6]. The bear’s concern regarding sales growth [E53, E60] fails to account for the fact that the company is currently flagged for accelerating earnings growth [E58] and profit growth exceeding 20% YoY [E57]. Furthermore, the claim that expectations are not ahead of delivery is refuted by the scanX signal engine, which explicitly notes that price growth is currently outpacing profit growth by 14% [E50]. The lack of any dividend yield [E4] provides no cushion for investors while they wait for these volatile growth metrics to stabilize. Conceded: [E6], [E57], [E58].
